# ADR 0113 — Build a true peer competitor: the integrated per-block RD lossless codec (clean-room)

- **Status:** Rejected (Phase 1 transform oracle failed; later measured candidates remain insufficient)
- **Date:** 2026-07-10
- **Extends:** ADR 0084 (cross-channel joint-coding frontier), ADR 0064 (beat-H.BWC warplan + integrated-RDO conclusion), ADR 0062 (H.BWC patent posture — oracle, never a dep), ADR 0054 (three-tier lossless)
- **Decision:** **Reject and halt** the proposed deterministic per-block RD codec after its Phase-1 transform oracle failed. Retain the forensic mine and candidate design below as historical evidence; do not restart Phases 2–7 without a new predictive lever and a new accepted ADR. Numbering: `0113`, first free integer after the BLUT premier-roadmap ADRs `0085–0112`.

## Context — the forensic mine (why, and what we're integrating)

The referential H.BWC gap (siena +4.16%, eegmmidb +2.30%) resisted every deterministic lever this campaign tried — fixed transforms, block-matching, cross-channel second-stages, KLT rotation, DCT-domain prediction proxies, and finally the affine cross-channel offset — all retired by measurement. A full teardown of the H.BWC reference (`reference/_ports/codec-hbwc/`, derivative-work port, oracle-only) + an **empirical per-tool ablation of the real EncoderApp** on referential EEG resolved *why*:

### Corrected H.BWC lossless architecture (primary source + port, verified)

| Stage | H.BWC actual mechanism | Our proxy got wrong |
|---|---|---|
| Transform | **NON-overlapping block IntDCT-II**, 3-lift Givens rotations via FFT lifting factorization, adaptive length 16–2048, pre-shift/no-post-shift lossless (`bwc-transform/dct.rs`, `rotate.rs`; `frame.rs:2090-2118`) | my MDCT (overlap) was structurally wrong; my ortho-float DCT missed integer-lifting + size-headroom |
| Transform decision | **per-block DCT vs transform-skip**, RD-chosen (`cgps_allow_transform_skip=1`) | I forced always-DCT ⇒ ate the penalty on predict-favoring blocks |
| Intra prediction | **spectral-neighbor LMS in the DCT-coefficient domain** (predict coeff from adjacent-freq neighbors), backward-adaptive sign-LMS order≤72 (`bwc-predict/lib.rs`, `frame.rs:2026-2088`) | I predicted same-bin across past blocks (temporal) ⇒ near-useless on non-overlap blocks |
| Cross-channel | **affine sample-domain LM** `cur≈scale·ref+offset`, per-block backward-LS, 16-sample template, 1–2 **signaled** best-refs (`bwc-crosschan/lib.rs`); **+ cc-LMS** (co-located coeffs, DCT domain, ≤31 refs, implicit contiguous) | our mv_rls is index-adjacent, no offset, no per-block ref selection |
| Quant | TCQ4 present but **RDOQ = 0% at lossless** (empirically) | — (a non-lever; kills that patent worry) |
| Entropy | CABAC-class BAC + **SBMP dual-rate** probability model; context = TCQ-coset ⊕ log-freq band ⊕ 3-tap neighbor-magnitude template (`ctx_dct.rs`, `sbmp.rs`) | our scale_cond is band+prev-1 only; but coder is <0.1% either way |
| Block-matching | **OFF for lossless EEG** (`UseBlockMatching=0`) | — (matches our finding it's spent) |

### Empirical per-tool ablation (real EncoderApp, siena 8ch, bit-exact lossless)

| toggle | Δ bits |
|---|---|
| force always-DCT (`transform_skip=0`) | **+3.14%** |
| no affine cross-channel LM (`UseLinearModel=0`) | **+3.45%** |
| RDOQ off | **0.00%** |

### Why single-lever mining is dead (proven)

`affine_xchan_probe` mined H.BWC's LM (its +3.45% lever) as a 2nd stage on our residual: the **DC-offset HURT** vs gain-only on every recording, and neither beat our container on referential. Each H.BWC lever's ablation value is relative to *H.BWC without it*, **not additive on our already-cross-channel-decorrelated residual**. The advantage is the **integrated per-block RD system** (ADR 0064's conclusion, now empirically nailed). Therefore a peer competitor must be built as that system, not as grafts.

## Decision — reject the deterministic per-block RD codec

The Phase-1 transform oracle failed, so the proposed LMP build is halted. The
design below is retained only as historical evidence. Phases 2–7 must not resume
without a new predictive lever, a measured gate that clears the shipped
container on referential EEG, and a new accepted ADR.

## Rejected proposal — the integrated per-block RD codec (clean-room, patent-clean)

The proposal was to build a new codec (working name **LMP**, a new LMO `transform_id`, in `lamquant-lml-optimum`) whose encoder made a **per-block rate decision** (lossless ⇒ RD collapses to R = actual coded bits) over an integrated candidate set, and whose decoder replayed the signaled per-block modes:

**Per block, keep-best over candidates:**
1. **transform-skip** = code the block's time-domain prediction residual directly (our mv_rls/predictor lineage — the "skip" side we already own).
2. **IntDCT** = reversible integer DCT-II of the block, then coefficient coding, with:
   - **intra spectral-neighbor LMS** on the coefficients (backward-adaptive, zero side-info),
   - **cc-LMS** cross-channel on co-located coefficients (backward-adaptive).
3. **affine cross-channel LM** (sample domain) with signaled best-reference — available to both branches.
4. per-block **on/off gating** of each predictor, RD-selected; mode bits signaled.

**Entropy back-end (patent-clean):** a context-adaptive binary/**rANS** coder (public-domain) carrying **our own contexts** — log-frequency band ⊕ **3-tap causal neighbor-magnitude template** (CALIC lineage) ⊕ a **dual-rate (fast/slow) probability estimator** (the one genuinely biosignal-motivated SBMP idea, re-derived clean). NO VVC BAC interval engine, NO `rpsTable2D`.

**Explicitly OUT (patent-walled / non-levers):** TCQ / dependent-quantization + its coset context, parity-mode magnitude coding, RDOQ (0% at lossless), the VVC BAC engine, HHI's exact IntDCT lifting tables / `LiftRealFFT` structure. The reversible integer DCT is re-derived from *public* lifting (Hao–Somani / Loeffler-style), not copied.

**Never-worse:** wired as an LMO keep-best candidate against the shipped container ⇒ cannot regress any recording; keeps our non-stationary + near-lossless-δ + MCU wins. The steelman for parity: a ratio-equal codec that ALSO deploys royalty-free on a \$2 MCU with a guaranteed-δ mode is a superior *product* at ratio parity.

## Rejected phased build plan (historical; do not execute)

- **Phase 0 — patent clearance** (gates shippable engine code): clean-room whitelist for the re-derived IntDCT factorization, sign-LMS constants (pick our own), rANS + context modeling. `codec-hbwc` stays oracle-only (ADR 0062). No Phase-2+ engine commit until the whitelist returns.
- **Phase 1 — per-block RD ORACLE de-risk** (build first, cheap, no engine): per block, `min(bits)` over the candidates we can already compute (mv_rls-predict-residual vs float-IntDCT-proxy-of-block + intra/cross variants), summed, vs the shipped container on all corpora. **Gate: the union oracle ≤ container on referential (siena/eegmmidb/tuar).** If the *ceiling* of per-block RD keep-best can't beat the container, the full codec can't either — stop and reconsider. If it clears, the build is validated.
- **Phase 2 — reversible IntDCT** (clean-room, public lifting) as an ABIR Reversible Pass; byte-exact round-trip; no_std decode.
- **Phase 3 — per-block RD candidate framework + transform-skip** (the +3.1% lever): the encoder RD loop + mode signaling + decoder replay.
- **Phase 4 — intra spectral-neighbor LMS** (DCT-coefficient domain, backward-adaptive).
- **Phase 5 — affine cross-channel LM + cc-LMS** (the +3.45% lever; signaled ref).
- **Phase 6 — clean context-adaptive rANS coder** (band ⊕ 3-tap template ⊕ dual-rate estimator).
- **Phase 7 — integrate + keep-best wiring + conformance** (byte-exact goldens, no_std, byte-equal backends, never-worse vs container), bench vs H.BWC oracle on all corpora; freeze this ADR with the measured result.

## Verification

- Phase 1: `ulimit -v 8388608; cargo run … --example perblock_rd_oracle_probe -- <all bins>`; success = oracle bps ≤ container on referential.
- Phases 2–7: byte-exact encode→decode goldens per corpus; `cargo build --no-default-features --target riscv32imac-unknown-none-elf`; byte-equal Firmware==Desktop; keep-best proven never-worse; final bench vs H.BWC on all corpora.
- Patent: Phase-0 whitelist archived before any shippable engine commit.

## Progress Log

- **2026-07-10** — ADR created. Forensic mine complete (3 subsystem teardowns + cfg + empirical ablation). Single-lever mining falsified (`affine_xchan_probe`, 9b0dc70). Decision: build the integrated per-block RD codec. Probes to date pushed to codec-lossless main: dct_domain (384d169), mdct_domain (f5c3b82), affine_xchan (9b0dc70). NEXT: Phase-1 per-block RD oracle de-risk.
- **2026-07-10 — Phase-1 gate FAILED; build HALTED (`perblock_rd_oracle_probe`, ce231fb).** Per-block RD oracle over {SKIP=mv_rls time residual, DCT+corrected-spectral-intra-LMS+cc} under Rice codelength: **DCTwin ≈ 0 on every recording** (0.00–0.73%) — the DCT branch never wins a block over our time-domain predictor, even with the corrected intra axis and an optimistic float-DCT proxy. **ORA/SKIP ≈ 0** — per-block RD adds nothing over just predicting. This is corroborated by H.BWC's own transform-skip ablation (+3.14% = H.BWC *escaping its own transform* because prediction beats DCT on EEG blocks; we are already 100% "skip"). **Conclusion: the integrated per-block RD TRANSFORM codec cannot beat our codec — the transform is dead weight for EEG.** A peer codec could only beat us via *better prediction* than mv_rls, which this campaign has shown does not graft (affine offset falsified, cross-channel second-stage loses referential, entropy coder tight). The deterministic-transform build is **not pursued**; the durable path to better-not-equal is the online-adaptive learned layer (ADR 0084 D4). The forensic mine (H.BWC architecture correction, ablation numbers, patent map) is retained as the permanent record. Status → this ADR records a **deterministic dead-end, honestly measured**; supersede only if a new predictive (not transform) lever is found.
- **2026-07-12 — deterministic granularity candidates measured; neither measured implementation closes the gap.** `per_channel_config_oracle_probe` charged a config tag plus exact MV-RLS/bias/entropy framing and gained only **0.12–0.56%** on the initial six-recording screen. `per_channel_branch_oracle_probe` then modeled the exact byte cost of a conservative, independently decodable per-channel framing for keep-best over the existing spatial/LML and MV-RLS branches; it does not serialize or decode that proposed framing. Across 36 local corpus recordings the model reduced complete-container bytes from **35,694,539 to 35,342,979 (−0.985%)**. Referential gains remained mostly below 1% (one conservative-framing result was +0.095%); a whole-container keep-best could make this never-worse. Shared framing or a new coder could improve on this conservative result, so it is **not a ceiling proof**. It is evidence that this concrete candidate remains below the known siena +4.16% / eegmmidb +2.30% deficits; do not promote it as an H.BWC win.
- **2026-07-12 — exploratory D4 learned-joint screen was positive but not a durable gate.** A scratch fixed-MLP probability-model run used disjoint `_0`/`_1` MV-RLS residual files and causal scale/history/prior-channel buckets. It indicated only **0.029–0.109 bit/sample** lower held-out bucket cross-entropy than a frozen scale-conditioned baseline. The script, split manifest, and result artifact were not retained, so these numbers are **non-reproducible exploratory evidence**, not an ADR acceptance/rejection gate. Re-run with a checked-in harness and actual integer-CDF bytes before making a learned-codec decision.
- **2026-07-12 — optional licensed envelope is the only aggregate ratio win, with a hard product boundary.** `tools/hbwc_bench/licensed_envelope.py` packs the smaller of independently produced LamQuant and H.BWC payloads behind an exact 6-byte dispatch header; it contains no H.BWC implementation or rights. On the saved 42-record held-out sweep it is **58,954,734 bytes vs H.BWC 59,017,524 bytes (−0.106392%)**, with three LamQuant payload wins. This is a tested optional route only for a caller that separately obtains lawful H.BWC codec/patent rights. Per ADR 0062 it is **not** the independent LamQuant codec, not patent-clean by implication, and not an acceptable basis for an unqualified “LamQuant beats H.BWC” claim.
- **2026-07-12 — current-head smoke refresh:** freshly rebuilt `lml` + `lossless_full` and HHI EncoderApp v5.0 both passed their lossless gates on 16 deterministic quick-sweep records. The licensed envelope was **20,770,699 vs H.BWC 20,861,277 bytes (−0.434192%) overall**, driven by two mental-arithmetic tuning wins. The 14-record held-out subset had no LamQuant payload wins, so the envelope was exactly 84 header bytes worse (**+0.000438%**). Full rows and command are archived in `tools/hbwc_bench/results/licensed_envelope_current_quick_2026-07-12.md`. This proves a current aggregate optional-route win, **not** a current held-out or independent-codec win.

# ADR 0114: The Neural Evidence Graph — a typed measurement/inference/generation substrate that makes the platform's invariants type errors instead of conventions

<!-- The title IS this ADR's one-line summary in the generated index/digest. -->

> **This file is append-only and living.** Write the decision once. As
> implementation proceeds, **append** dated entries to the Progress Log — never
> rewrite or delete earlier text; correct an earlier statement with a *new* dated
> entry beneath it. When the deliverable passes its gate, fill **Completion** and
> set Status to `Complete — frozen YYYY-MM-DD`.

## Status

`Proposed 2026-07-10`. **Accepted + frozen 2026-07-18** — the N0–N3 gate is met
(crate exists, the `Node<Generated>`→`Node<Measured>` barrier is an E0308 compile
error, one real NEG round-trips to a stable content address) and the first real
consumer (ADR 0115 R4, calibration + uncertainty edges) is wired. See Completion.

Foundation slice of the **LamQuant Ω** north-star (the "Open Neural Observatory"
vision — the compiler/runtime for neural measurement). Ω spans seven horizons;
this ADR builds *only* the type substrate underneath all of them — Horizon I/II
plumbing — and explicitly defers the query compiler, the personal digital twin,
the autonomous experiment engine, and the closed-loop action plane to separate,
later ADRs that **consume** this graph (see Non-goals).

Builds on: ADR 0069/0074 (ABIR — the modality-typed `Measured` substrate), ADR
0068 (the LML/LMQ contract split — lossless-diagnosis vs generative-monitoring),
ADR 0067 D5 (`src/lineage_db.rs` cross-host `status.jsonl`), the P2P artifact
data-plane (content-addressed file-backed handles), and the LQS grading surface
(`evaluation/openecs/src/levels.rs`).

## Context

The LamQuant Ω vision rests on ten non-negotiable invariants. The three
load-bearing ones are already the DNA of the system — but each is enforced today
by **discipline and convention scattered across subsystems**, not by a single
type system:

1. **Measurement and inference are different types; the system must not silently
   cast one into the other.** Today this lives in the LML/LMQ split (ADR 0068):
   LML is the grounded lossless diagnosis surface, LMQ is the generative
   monitoring surface. But the split is a *product* boundary, not a *type*
   boundary — nothing structural stops an LMQ reconstruction from being written
   into a field, cited in a doc, or fed to a downstream model as though it were
   measured.
2. **Generative content is never evidence.** ADR 0068 makes "hallucinated
   plausible morphology" acceptable *for LMQ's monitoring job* — precisely
   because it is understood to be non-diagnostic. That understanding is carried
   in prose and reviewer vigilance, not in a `Generated` type that a consumer
   physically cannot mistake for `Measured`.
3. **Every conclusion is replayable** (provenance: hardware, firmware, codec,
   model, data, transform). Fragments exist — `lineage_db` records cross-host
   status, ABIR records `provenance` on atoms, the artifact plane is
   content-addressed, the doc composer transcludes ledger numbers — but there is
   no one graph in which a result node points back through its calibration,
   transform, model-version, and uncertainty edges to the measured nodes it
   stands on.

This project has a **documented history of exactly the failure this prevents**:
`feedback_doc_truth_recurring_lies` and `feedback_poller_confabulates_metrics`
record confident fictions (an R of 0.81/0.85/0.93 that was never achieved; a
fabricated val-R trajectory) leaking into docs and digests because a *narrated
number* and a *measured number* were the same type — a string — and nothing
refused the cast. ABIR fixed this for *biosignal modality* (a modality-less file
is invalid; `Abir<Ecg>` cannot reach an `Eeg` consumer; the compile-fail test
`front_end_bit_exact` + typestate markers make wrong-modality a build error).
The Neural Evidence Graph generalizes ABIR's move — "make the illegal state
unrepresentable" — from *which modality* to *what epistemic class of value this
is*.

Without this substrate, every Ω horizon above it (progressive risk-limiting
codec, universal/personal models, autonomous experiments, closed-loop action)
would each re-implement, and eventually each violate, the measured/inferred/
generated distinction in its own way.

## Decision

Define the **Neural Evidence Graph (NEG)**: a typed, content-addressed
serialization schema — plus a Rust type layer and a verifier — in which every
value the platform produces is one of **seven node classes**, connected by one of
**eight edge classes**, such that:

- **`Measured`, `Estimated`, and `Generated` are distinct types**, and a consumer
  that requires `Measured` evidence **cannot be handed** an `Estimated` or
  `Generated` node without a verified, one-way, explicitly-named promotion
  boundary — a compile error in Rust, a verify-time raise across the PyO3/Python
  boundary (the exact mechanism ABIR uses for modality).
- **Provenance is intrinsic to the node, not attached alongside it.** A `Derived`
  or `Estimated` node carries the content-addressed hashes of the nodes it was
  computed from and the named transform/model/calibration that produced it;
  replay is following provenance edges, not consulting a side log.
- **The graph is the currency**, not a per-subsystem structure. The codec, the
  trainer, the eval harness, and the orchestrator all emit and consume NEG nodes;
  `.abir`/`.lml`/`.lmq` atoms become the payloads that `Measured`/`Derived`/
  `Estimated`/`Generated` nodes point at.

This ADR ships the **schema + Rust type layer + verifier + serde + the Python
boundary handle**, and nothing above it. It does not build any consumer of the
graph beyond the tests that prove the type discipline holds.

### Node classes (mapped to what exists today)

| Node | Meaning | Already implicit in |
|---|---|---|
| **Measured** | a value a sensor produced, with timestamp, position, reference, calibration id, hardware state, integrity | ABIR `Abir<M>` atoms (born-typed, verifier-checked) — ADR 0069/0074 |
| **Derived** | a *deterministic* transform whose provenance replays exactly | LML lossless encodings; doc-composer transclusions; `Reversible` ABIR passes |
| **Estimated** | a *posterior* from a named model over named evidence (carries uncertainty) | LMQ near-lossless recon + LQS grade; SNN state; entropy-model rate |
| **Generated** | a synthetic/enhanced sample, permanently labeled, never substitutable for `Measured` | LMQ generative decoder output, GAN samples (ADR 0068) |
| **Hypothesis** | a proposition with explicit supporting/contradicting evidence | ADRs; the codec-/lossless-technique-mine backlogs; DON'T-retry lists |
| **Action** | a stimulus/command/experiment choice with constraints + authorization | *none today* — nearest is a PCCP change-request; **deferred, see Non-goals** |
| **Outcome** | the measured response after an Action | *none today* — eval/gate PASS-FAIL is the nearest shape |

### Edge classes

`deterministic-transform` · `probabilistic-inference` · `temporal-dependence` ·
`spatial-correspondence` · `causal-intervention` · `calibration-dependency` ·
`provenance-dependency` · `uncertainty-propagation`.

### Where it lives

NEG is **foundational**, like ABIR — consumers depend *down* on it, never the
reverse. The type layer is a new Rust crate `lamquant-neg` that depends only on
`lamquant-common` + `lamquant-abir` (a `Measured` node wraps an ABIR atom;
`Derived`/`Estimated`/`Generated` reference payloads by content hash). The
serialization is deterministic content-addressed JSON — the same currency the
artifact data-plane already ships — so the Python training/eval path and the BLUT
orchestrator consume the exact same schema without a Rust dependency. Python gets
a typed handle (`neg.measured()`/`neg.estimated()`/`neg.generated()`) that raises
on a wrong-class access, never a class-blind dict — mirroring ABIR's
`.eeg()`/`.ecg()` boundary.

```
lamquant-common  ←  lamquant-abir  ←  lamquant-neg  ←  { LML, LMQ, training, eval, BLUT }
```

## Rationale

- **The invariants already exist; only their enforcement is soft.** This is not a
  new philosophy — it is the mechanization of ADR 0068's LML/LMQ split and the
  `doc-truth` discipline into a type the compiler and the PyO3 boundary enforce.
  The cheapest, highest-leverage thing extractable from the whole Ω vision.
- **ABIR proved the pattern in-repo.** "Make the illegal state unrepresentable"
  already shipped for modality (typestate markers, verifier on read/promotion/
  PyO3, a compile-fail test). NEG reuses that exact machinery for epistemic class
  — low technical risk, proven ergonomics.
- **It is a prerequisite, not a competitor, to every higher horizon.** The
  risk-limiting progressive codec, the personal twin, and the autonomous
  experiment engine each need to distinguish measured from inferred from
  generated. Building that once, underneath, stops three future subsystems from
  each re-deriving (and eventually violating) it.
- **Content-addressed provenance edges make replay structural.** A result that
  can name — by hash — the measured nodes, calibration, transforms, and model
  versions it stands on is auditable by construction; the `confabulated-metric`
  class of bug becomes representationally impossible on this path.

## Alternatives Considered

- **Keep the status quo (soft enforcement: LML/LMQ product split + reviewer
  vigilance + `lineage_db` side log).** Rejected as the *sole* mechanism: it is
  exactly what let confident fictions into docs before (`doc-truth`,
  `poller-confabulates`). A convention that has already been violated is not an
  invariant.
- **Bolt the node classes onto ABIR as more `Modality`-style typestate.**
  Rejected: epistemic class is orthogonal to modality (an EEG value can be
  Measured *or* Generated), and NEG spans non-biosignal nodes (Hypothesis,
  Action, Outcome, model-version, calibration) that have no place in a biosignal
  IR. NEG depends on ABIR; it is not part of it.
- **Build the full Neural Evidence Graph from the Ω doc — with the query
  compiler, twin, experiment engine, and action plane.** Rejected as scope: those
  are consumers with their own hard, partly-unproven mechanisms (the twin's
  cross-window predictability is empirically weak in this codebase — the LTP/
  Koopman probes found little; the action plane is a categorically different
  regulatory posture). Shipping the type substrate first lets each land as its
  own gated ADR without blocking on the substrate.

## Consequences

- A new foundational crate `lamquant-neg` that the codec, trainer, eval, and
  orchestrator version against; the artifact plane's content-addressing becomes
  the provenance-edge mechanism.
- `Estimated`/`Generated` outputs (every LMQ result, every LQS grade) must be
  *born* as their class — a one-time boundary cost at each producer, paid once.
- The `promote(Estimated → Measured)` boundary must be explicit, verified, and
  rare (it should essentially never happen — an estimate is not a measurement);
  its existence is auditable and any use is a reviewable event.
- Becomes load-bearing for the risk-limiting codec (ADR-to-come): "transmit until
  calibrated sufficiency" needs `uncertainty-propagation` edges to define
  sufficiency; NEG is where those edges live.
- Does **not** touch the LML byte-exact wire, the PCCP gate, or any trained model
  — it is a wrapper/typing layer above the payloads, so it cannot regress codec
  correctness or perf.

## Implementation Plan  *(the contract — amend only by a dated Progress Log entry)*

- **Deliverable:** the `lamquant-neg` crate — the seven `Node` classes + eight
  `Edge` classes as Rust types with ZST-typestate on the epistemic class
  (`Node<Measured>` / `Node<Estimated>` / `Node<Generated>`), a `verify()` pass, a
  deterministic content-addressed serde form, and a PyO3 typed handle that raises
  on wrong-class access. First real producers wired: LMQ output → `Generated`,
  LQS grade → `Estimated`, an ABIR atom → `Measured`.
- **Phasing** (each slice lands with tests):
  - **N0** — schema + Rust types + typestate + serde round-trip (no consumers).
  - **N1** — the verifier + the compile-fail test (a `Node<Generated>` cannot
    reach a `fn requires(&Node<Measured>)`; the promotion boundary is the only
    bridge and is a named, logged op).
  - **N2** — the PyO3 handle + a Python-side raise-on-wrong-class test.
  - **N3** — wire the three real producers (LMQ/LQS/ABIR) so the first genuine
    NEG is emitted end-to-end for one validation window, with provenance edges
    back to the measured atom.
- **Acceptance gate (fail-CLOSED; unmeasured ⇒ FAIL):**
  - `gate_cmd:` `cargo test -p lamquant-neg && python -m pytest <neg python boundary tests>`
  - `pass when:` exit==0 AND the compile-fail test confirms `Node<Generated> →
    requires(Node<Measured>)` does not compile (captured via `trybuild`), AND a
    round-tripped NEG re-hashes identically (content-address stable), AND the
    Python handle raises on `.measured()` over a `Generated` node.
- **Rollback:** `lamquant-neg` is additive and depended-on only by new producer
  wiring; reverting the crate + the N3 producer edits restores prior behavior
  byte-for-byte (no wire/model/PCCP change to undo).

## Progress Log  *(append-only; newest last; never rewrite an earlier entry)*

- _2026-07-10 — opened._ Grounded in ABIR's shipped modality-typestate pattern
  (ADR 0069/0074) and the ADR 0068 LML/LMQ split. Scoped hard to the type
  substrate; query compiler / twin / experiment engine / action plane deferred to
  consumer ADRs. Next: scaffold `lamquant-neg` N0 (schema + typestate + serde).
- _2026-07-10 — N0 LANDED_ (codec-lossless `d7a7807` + review-fix `f717c6e`).
  New crate `codec-lossless/crates/lamquant-neg` (host/std): the sealed
  `EpistemicClass` typestate (Measured/Derived/Estimated/Generated/Hypothesis/
  Action/Outcome), zero-cost `Node<C>` over an erased serializable `NodeRecord`,
  SHA-256 content addressing (order-independent), the eight `EdgeClass` relations,
  and `NegGraph` with typed `view::<C>`, provenance-edge materialization, and a
  fail-closed `verify` (tamper / dangling / unknown-class / non-finite-uncertainty).
  The one deliberate `promote(Estimated→Measured)` boundary records its source.
  **N0 gate met:** `cargo test -p lamquant-neg` green (24 unit + 2 doctests); the
  `compile_fail,E0308` doctest proves `Node<Generated>` cannot reach a
  `&Node<Measured>` consumer; graph content-address round-trips stably. Reviewed
  via `review_commit` (PASS WITH NITS → kebab-serde/hex-dedup/finite-gate applied;
  3 FPs skipped, recorded in `f717c6e`). Next: N1 (a standalone `trybuild` gate in
  CI) then N2 (PyO3 typed handle) / N3 (wire LMQ→Generated, LQS→Estimated,
  ABIR-atom→Measured for one real window).
- _2026-07-18 — N1–N3 LANDED_ (codec-lossless `ada5acc`/`a17c69f`/`163b86c`/`c5c6b18`;
  cookbook blut-lamquant N3). **N1:** trybuild UI test + committed `.stderr`
  pinning `error[E0308]` "expected `&Node<Measured>`, found `&Node<Generated>`",
  plus a named `cargo test -p lamquant-neg` CI gate. **N2:** `PyNeg` PyO3 handle
  in `lamquant-py` (mirrors `PyAbir`'s `typed<M>` promotion) — the typed accessors
  `.measured()/.estimated()/.generated()` raise `ValueError` on a class mismatch;
  6 pytest boundary tests; the release rebuild also replaced a stale 95 MB debug
  `lamquant_core.so`. **N3:** `lamquant/eval/neg_emit.py` emits a real 3-node NEG
  for one frozen-E1 (`joint_e1`, pinned in `frozen_e1.py`) `codec_ready` val window
  (`PN05-2#w0`): Measured (fb + sha256, keyed `(lma_path,stem,win_idx)`) → Estimated
  (LQS R/PRD as uncertainty) + Generated (recon), with provenance +
  probabilistic-inference edges; verify()s clean, round-trips to a stable content
  address. **Fixed a real N0 bug found by N3:** the content address hashed the
  uncertainty f64's raw IEEE-754 bytes, which are not JSON-round-trip-stable —
  switched to hashing/serializing the value's std `Display` string (Rust + Python
  regression tests). **N0–N3 gate met.** Next consumer: ADR 0115 R4 (emit
  calibration + uncertainty-propagation edges through NEG).

## Completion / Resolution  *(fill once; this + the frozen Status line is the freeze mark)*

_**Resolved `Accepted` 2026-07-18.** The N0–N3 gate passed: `lamquant-neg` ships
the 7-class epistemic typestate + 8 edge kinds; the `Node<Generated>` →
`Node<Measured>` barrier is a pinned `E0308` compile-fail test (`trybuild`) + a
named `cargo test -p lamquant-neg` CI gate; the `PyNeg` PyO3 handle preserves the

# ADR 0115: Make LMQ risk-limiting — spend measured bytes until calibrated scientific sufficiency, then escape to LML

> **This file is append-only and living.** Amend implementation state through
> dated Progress Log entries. Freeze only after the held-out research gate passes.

## Status

`Proposed 2026-07-12`. R0 policy-evaluation scaffold in progress; research
claim unmeasured and therefore FAIL.

Builds on ADR 0068 (LMQ finite-rate contract), ADR 0070 D.4 (variable-rate
experiment), ADR 0114 (typed uncertainty/provenance substrate), and LML's
deterministic lossless contract. This ADR does not replace any of them.

## Context

LMQ already has most machinery commonly described as an adaptive codec:

- a measured finite-FSQ ladder over `L in {2,3,5,8,16,32}`;
- a reconstruction-difficulty labeler that finds the minimum level meeting a
  distortion threshold;
- an SNN-to-rate design and historical adaptive packet implementation; and
- an experimental multi-scale FSQ path over coarse-to-fine temporal grids.

Missing mechanism is stronger: a controller that may claim *sufficiency* only
when a held-out calibration procedure bounds declared scientific failure, and
that abstains to a deterministic lossless representation otherwise. A learned
difficulty class or uncalibrated scalar is not such a bound.

Three existing facts constrain design:

1. Current finite-rate reports use `latent_dim * latent_T * log2(L)`, not real
   serialized packet bytes. Headers, entropy tables, schedules, retransmission,
   and escape bytes must enter rate accounting before any savings claim.
2. Existing FSQ levels are alternative grids, not nested refinement layers.
   `L2 -> L3 -> L5` requires replacement symbols unless a new residual or
   bitplane representation makes enhancement bytes independently decodable.
3. EEG windows from one patient/session are dependent. Calibration and test
   exchangeability live at patient/session block level, not random-window level.

Therefore first experiment is an offline policy test, not model training,
firmware control, active acquisition, or a new bitstream.

## Decision

Build a **risk-limiting LMQ controller** with four explicit outcomes:

1. choose the cheapest candidate layer whose calibrated upper bounds satisfy
   every declared scientific-risk threshold;
2. choose a richer candidate when a cheaper candidate cannot be certified;
3. abstain to exact LML when no lossy candidate can be certified; or
4. abstain immediately when the OOD contract fires.

The controller consumes predictions produced by a predictor fitted without any
calibration/test patient. Split conformal calibration then operates on patient
or session groups. For thresholds `tau_e`, endpoint `e`, observation `i`, and
layer `k`, use normalized nonconformity

```text
s_g = max over i in group g, k, e
      (risk(i,k,e) - predicted_risk(i,k,e)) / tau_e

q = finite-sample upper conformal quantile of {s_g}

upper_risk(i,k,e) = predicted_risk(i,k,e) + max(0,q) * tau_e
```

Taking one maximum across windows, layers, and endpoints makes the calibrated
event simultaneous within a group; it avoids silently multiplying endpoint
error rates. If calibration-group count cannot support requested alpha,
`q = +inf` and every lossy candidate abstains. Calibration never tightens a
predictor (`q` is clamped at zero).

Candidate order is **measured cumulative bytes**, not FSQ level number. This is
load-bearing: a replacement-grid experiment must count all bytes sent so far;
a future nested bitstream may count only base plus enhancement bytes.

### R0 input contract

One JSONL record per window:

```json
{
  "window_id": "corpus/patient/session/window",
  "group_id": "patient-or-session-calibration-unit",
  "corpus": "tueg",
  "split": "calibration",
  "predictor_id": "risk-head-fit-sha256",
  "ood": false,
  "fallback_bytes": 81234,
  "fallback_exact": true,
  "layers": [
    {
      "name": "L2",
      "cumulative_bytes": 428,
      "predicted_risks": {"worst_channel_prd": 0.18},
      "actual_risks": {"worst_channel_prd": 0.21}
    }
  ]
}
```

`actual_risks` are evaluation-only labels. Runtime selection reads only
`predicted_risks`, OOD state, calibration artifact, and byte costs.

## Non-goals for first gate

- No claim that alternative FSQ grids are progressive.
- No learned router or predictor training.
- No active electrode/sample acquisition; unsampled evidence cannot use a
  downstream lossless escape.
- No generative packet concealment presented as measurement.
- No permanent clinical guarantee under arbitrary distribution shift.
- No change to LML bytes, LMQ bytes, firmware, or PCCP registry.

## Phased implementation

### R0 — Calibration-only policy evaluator

Add dependency-free evaluator and tests. It must:

- calibrate on independent patient/session groups;
- fail closed on insufficient calibration groups, missing endpoints, non-finite
  values, missing actual byte counts, or non-exact fallback;
- select by cumulative bytes;
- force fallback on declared OOD;
- report per-corpus coverage, abstention, bytes, fixed-policy comparison, and
  per-window non-monotonicity observations; and
- keep measurement generation separate from policy calibration.

R0 proves evaluator semantics only. It does not satisfy research gate.

### R1 — Real measurement adapter

Extend finite-rate evaluation to emit R0 rows using subject-stable IDs, declared
fit/calibration/test manifests, multiple task profiles, and real serialized LMQ
and LML packet sizes. Reconcile current LMQ wire documentation before selecting
an encoder. The adapter must never substitute `log2(L)` for packet bytes.

### R2 — Temporal-density oracle, then nested wire

First measure the `{20,40,79}` temporal oracle by downsample/upsample controls at
matched bytes. If it wins, migrate experimental multi-scale FSQ onto the
canonical quantizer. Introduce either residual enhancement packets or a nested
power-of-two grid. Prove prefix decode and cumulative-byte monotonicity. Static
pooling at the same average token count is mandatory control.

### R3 — Deterministic escape envelope

Define an auditable window envelope carrying either certified LMQ layers or an
exact LML window. Missing/failed calibration, corrupt uncertainty provenance,
OOD, and exhausted lossy layers all select LML. Generative data remains typed
`Generated`; it never becomes `Measured` through fallback.

### R4 — NEG, PCCP, and firmware integration

Emit calibration and uncertainty-propagation edges through NEG after ADR 0114
N2/N3. Any model/router change follows PCCP. Firmware integration begins only
after offline held-out gate passes.

## Research acceptance gate

### Inputs

- frozen E1 encoder/decoder checkpoints;
- candidate FSQ layers, with any temporal candidates added only after R2 gives
  them real cumulative packet bytes;
- predictor-fit patients disjoint from calibration and test;
- calibration patients;
- unseen test patients; and
- at least one corpus absent from predictor fit and calibration.

### Pass when

All conditions must hold:

1. risk-limited policy uses fewer pooled **serialized cumulative bytes** than
   the cheapest calibrated fixed layer;
2. both policies satisfy the predeclared held-out patient-group failure bound;
3. every declared endpoint is covered simultaneously by the calibration event;
4. unseen-corpus groups either satisfy the same bound or abstain 100% under a
   predeclared OOD rule;
5. every escape payload decodes byte-exactly to measured input;
6. monotonicity violations are reported and never hidden by assuming higher L
   means lower scientific risk; and
7. all artifacts carry split-manifest, checkpoint, predictor, calibration, and
   encoder hashes.

Any missing measurement, absent fixed-policy comparator, insufficient
calibration groups, unknown packet size, or non-exact fallback is FAIL.

## Rollback

R0/R1 are additive evaluation paths. Remove evaluator and measurement adapter;
fixed-rate codec behavior remains byte-for-byte unchanged. R2+ bitstream work
must use a new version/magic and retain old decoder compatibility. R3 remains
opt-in until full gate passes.

## Progress Log

- _2026-07-12 — opened._ Repository audit found finite-rate sweep and
  reconstruction-difficulty oracle already implemented, multi-scale FSQ
  experimental but grid-incompatible, NEG N0 landed, and adaptive LMQ wire
  documentation contradictory. Decision: build group-calibrated policy evaluator
  first; do not call alternative FSQ grids progressive or estimated rates actual.
- _2026-07-12 — R0 SCAFFOLD IMPLEMENTED (research gate still FAIL)._ Added
  dependency-free `lamquant.eval.risk_limited_policy`: strict JSONL contract,
  patient/session-group simultaneous split-conformal correction, cumulative-byte
  layer selection, exact/OOD fallback, calibrated fixed-layer comparator,
  unseen-corpus checks, and monotonicity reporting. Focused unit suite: 11 passed.
  This is evaluator semantics only; R1 has not emitted real measurement rows, so
  no rate, coverage, or scientific-sufficiency claim exists yet.
- _2026-07-18 — R1 REAL-BYTE ADAPTER LANDED (research gate still FAIL by design)._
  Added `lamquant.eval.fsq_entropy` (static-model rANS serializer over the integer
  FSQ codes `round(latent/step)`, step=2/L; one shared per-level frequency table,
  Laplace-smoothed to TOTAL=32768, fail-closed lossless round-trip per window) and
  `lamquant.eval.eval_risk_limited_bytes` (measurement driver), + 15 serializer
  tests. Cookbook commit `86aa711`. The adapter **never substitutes log2(L)** —
  every `cumulative_bytes` is an actual rANS packet, round-trip-verified.
  Measurement: frozen E1 (`joint_e1`) over the `codec_ready` **val** split
  (Siena PN\* + EEGMMI S\*), 239 windows, **58 calibration / 58 test SUBJECT
  groups**, disjoint total-variation predictor-fit pool, endpoint = worst-channel
  PRD% over signal-carrying channels (a flat/reference channel is excluded, not
  floored to a 1e13% "worst channel"), fallback = real zstd lossless size.

  **Finding 1 — real bytes are BELOW the old estimate.** Median serialized bytes
  vs the historical `latent_dim·latent_T·log2(L)` estimate:

  | L | real rANS bytes | log2(L) estimate | median worst-ch PRD% |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | 2 | 241 | 316 | 349 |
  | 3 | 418 | 500 | 198 |
  | 5 | 594 | 733 | 122 |
  | 8 | 797 | 948 | 104 |
  | 16 | 1105 | 1264 | 98 |
  | 32 | 1419 | 1580 | 97 |

  The rANS packet is 15–25% smaller than the estimate at every layer (the FSQ code
  histogram is skewed, so entropy coding beats the uniform-`log2(L)` bound). The
  prior finite-rate curve therefore **over-counted** deployed bytes. Lossless
  fallback (zstd, exact float32 window) median 102.8 KB, so lossy layers are
  100–400× smaller than exact — the escape is expensive, as intended.

  **Finding 2 — the risk-limiting policy does NOT yet beat a fixed layer.** Across
  thresholds {150,250,400,600}% × α{0.1,0.2}, `serialized_byte_savings` is FALSE in
  every cell; the group-conformal correction is large (0.78–4.4) because the
  **marginal TV predictor's** residuals dominate, so the policy over-abstains to
  the lossless escape (fallback rate 1.0 at strict thresholds; 0.25 only at
  600%/α0.2, still net-negative savings). Held-out patient-group failure rate is
  0.00 throughout (the escape is safe), and non-monotonicity is reported, not
  hidden. This is the correct, informative R1 outcome: the machinery is real and
  the win is not faked — the missing lever is a **real per-window difficulty
  predictor** (the SNN recon-difficulty labeler), not a total-variation proxy.

  Reproduce: `eval_risk_limited_bytes.py --split val --max-windows 360
  --max-windows-per-subject 3 --device cpu --out rows.jsonl` then
  `python -m lamquant.eval.risk_limited_policy --input rows.jsonl --alpha 0.1
  --threshold worst_channel_prd_pct=400`. (Policy reviewer `review_commit` was
  down — provider 401 — so `86aa711` shipped without the MiMo pass; infra, not a
  code defect. Self-audited: continuous-encode codes are bit-identical to what
  `codec(cx)` quantizes internally; every reported byte count is a verified
  lossless round-trip.) The §"Research acceptance gate" conditions (savings +
  disjoint-corpus + held-out bound) remain unmet → still FAIL.
- _2026-07-18 — R4 (NEG calibration/uncertainty edges) LANDED._
  `lamquant.eval.neg_policy` (cookbook `6bf6a8d`) emits the policy's calibration +
  uncertainty structure through the ADR 0114 NEG — the graph's first real consumer
  beyond its own demo. Per test window: `Measured` source → `Estimated` predicted
  risk (uncertainty = worst-endpoint predicted value) → `Derived` decision, plus a
  shared `Estimated` conformal-correction node with `calibration-dependency` edges
  into every decision and `uncertainty-propagation` edges into every predicted
  risk. The graph `verify()`s and round-trips to a stable content address; the
  epistemic invariant holds (correction + predicted risks are non-evidence
  `Estimated`; the decision is evidence-grade `Derived`; the source is `Measured`).
  A non-finite correction (insufficient calibration groups → +inf) still builds and
  verifies. 2 tests green. The evaluator stays graph-free; this adapter consumes it.
  (R4's PCCP + firmware integration remain gated on the held-out research gate,
  still FAIL per R1.)

## Completion / Resolution

_Pending. Unmeasured research claim remains FAIL._

# ADR 0116: Build LamQuant Optimum v2 as a frozen learned lossless peer codec

> **This file is append-only and living.** Amend implementation state through
> dated Progress Log entries. Freeze only after the blind actual-byte gate.

## Status

`Accepted 2026-07-12` → `In progress 2026-07-12`. Research and production gates
remain FAIL until measured.

## Context

Optimum v1 is a deterministic LMO keep-best codec. The authoritative held-out
campaign remains behind EncoderApp v5 overall, with its hardest referential
gaps at Siena and EEGMMIDB. ADR 0084 localized the
remaining frontier to nonlinear joint cross-channel structure. ADR 0113 then
rejected the deterministic per-block transform peer after its optimistic oracle
found almost no DCT-winning blocks. Its later scratch learned screen suggested
0.029--0.109 bit/sample but retained no harness, split, model, or integer-CDF
bytes, so it is not evidence.

ADR 0052 prohibited learned models inside Optimum to keep LMO deterministic and
outside PCCP. That boundary now blocks the only measured-open frontier. Frozen
integer model tables are deterministic codec state: a decoder with a named table
and exact arithmetic produces one result. They are still learned AI/ML assets
and must be governed as such; determinism does not exempt their training or
promotion from PCCP.

Current `LMO1` already uses wire version 2. "Optimum v2" therefore names the
product generation, while its first wire is `LMO1` version 3. Existing version
2 remains readable forever. Historical version-1 support is not claimed until a
retained golden proves it.

## Decision

Build **LamQuant Optimum v2**, a ground-up EEG-first lossless codec whose
normative fixed integer tables are first-class decoder assets. Its independent
body combines a causal joint probability model, serialized channel graph,
optional reversible integer coupling, fixed integer CDF construction, and rANS.
It may use only native raw/delta escape modes; it never embeds or selects an
H.BWC, AV2, LML, or Optimum-v1 payload. Keep `LMO1` magic, assign wire version 3,
and carry it under BCS1 codec descriptor `0x03`. CPU is the reference decoder;
GPU acceleration must emit byte-identical states and samples. EEG is the first
release gate; ECG/EMG follow only after the EEG peer passes.

This decision supersedes ADR 0052's deterministic-only restriction **for
Optimum v2 only**. Optimum v1 remains unchanged. It extends ADR 0084 D4 and does
not reopen ADR 0113's rejected transform design.

## Rationale

- The deterministic predictor/transform/coder family has been measured near its
  ceiling; nonlinear joint modeling is the remaining evidence-backed frontier.
- A reversible flow cannot reduce true entropy by itself. It remains a gated
  candidate and ships only if it improves actual bytes over the same learned
  prior without flow.
- Fixed versioned tables make archived decode reproducible. Model changes create
  new model IDs; old tables are retained.
- Host-first removes the MCU/no_std capacity ceiling while preserving a portable
  CPU reference. Existing LML firmware gates remain isolation regressions.
- Complete stream bytes, not cross-entropy, residual energy, or a min-envelope,
  decide every architecture and product claim.

## Alternatives Considered

- **Extend Optimum v1 with another deterministic transform.** Rejected by ADR
  0113's transform oracle and the earlier fixed-transform campaign.
- **Learn only post-hoc probabilities over the existing codec.** Retained as a
  mandatory control, not the product assumption; it cannot establish a novel
  graph/flow contribution.
- **New `LMO2` magic.** Rejected by owner decision. Product generation and wire
  generation are separate; `LMO1` version 3 provides unambiguous dispatch.
- **MCU/no_std learned decoder first.** Deferred. Initial goal is maximum fair
  compression ratio; a deterministic native slot and MCU design follow later.
- **Licensed H.BWC/AV2 envelope.** Rejected as the independent peer. EncoderApp
  stays an external, version-pinned measurement oracle only.

## Consequences

- New `lamquant-lml-optimum-v2` crate, `BGF1` body, `LQW1` model pack, ABIR-aware
  window-codec seam, and BCS1 descriptor `0x03`.
- New raw-digital training/evaluation path. No filtering, resampling, or
  cross-split normalization may alter lossless inputs.
- New PCCP model class `optimum_v2_bgf`; current A/B/C/D classes cannot promote it.
- Fixed model bytes count as codec assets, not per-record payload. Reports must
  include package size and 1/10/60-minute amortized rates.
- Existing 42-record sweep becomes development-only because it has informed
  architecture choices. Final evidence uses a new sealed patient/session/content-
  hash-disjoint manifest and a whole-corpus external test.

## Implementation Plan  *(the contract -- amend only by a dated Progress Log entry)*

- **Deliverable:** `LMO1` v3 / `BGF1` exact-lossless codec, canonical `LQW1`
  bundle, manifest-driven benchmark, governed model record, and blind result.
- **Acceptance gate (fail-CLOSED; unmeasured => FAIL):**
  - `gate_cmd:` `python3 tools/hbwc_bench/optimum_v2_sweep.py --manifest <sealed.json> --manifest-sha256 <sha256> --split blind --split external_test --candidate-command '["<candidate-adapter>"]' --reference-command '["python3","tools/hbwc_bench/hbwc_codec_adapter.py"]' --candidate-model <model.lqw> --parity-evidence <parity.json> --out <result.json> --enforce-release-gate`
  - `pass when:` zero skipped/failed/mismatched records; complete candidate bytes
    are <=99% of H.BWC; paired subject-bootstrap 95% upper byte-delta bound is
    below zero; Siena and EEGMMIDB are each <=100%; every other internal corpus
    and the external corpus are <=101%; CPU/GPU/cross-language states are exact.
- **Rollback:** remove descriptor `0x03`, v2 crate, model registration, and v2
  facade wiring. LML and LMO versions 1--2 remain byte-identical and decodable.

## Progress Log  *(append-only; newest last; never rewrite an earlier entry)*

- _2026-07-12 -- opened and accepted._ Owner decisions: learned flow + entropy
  are first-class frozen tables; host CPU and GPU allowed; EEG first; product v2
  uses `LMO1` wire v3; fixed tables are codec assets; blind win floor is 1%.
  Existing deterministic-only Optimum restriction is superseded for v2. Next:
  O2-0 fail-closed manifest and complete-stream benchmark.
- _2026-07-12 -- O2-0/O2-1/O2-2 first vertical slices landed._ The benchmark
  now rejects source-path leakage into decoders, duplicate content/IDs,
  non-finite gates, stale outputs, missing release splits, missing manifest
  pins, and oversized inputs. A real EncoderApp/DecoderApp smoke reconstructed
  2 channels x 2,500 samples exactly; the DecoderApp WAV rate tag is known-bad,
  so the common acquisition rate is supplied to both adapters. The independent
  `OV2P` research coder now emits actual scale-conditioned integer rANS bytes
  for causal graph plus research-only floating RLS screens and decodes exactly
  in-process. Floating RLS is not cross-platform parity evidence. Its first short development
  measurements remain losses; the pinned first-slice report is
  `tools/hbwc_bench/results/optimum_v2_first_actual_bytes_2026-07-12.md`.
  Therefore no peer/win claim is made. The Rust crate now provides
  bounded `LMO1` v3 / `BGF1` native raw/delta packets, CRC32C, canonical `LQW1`
  integer model packs, BCS descriptor `0x03`, and host-facade isolation. Learned
  BGF execution, the BCS container writer/reader route, sealed manifests,
  cross-language identity, and the blind gate remain open.
- _2026-07-12 -- O2-3 release enforcement held fail-CLOSED._ Hash-bound,
  caller-authored parity claims do not prove CPU/GPU or Python/Rust state
  equality. The release path now rejects every invocation until a checked-in
  producer/verifier recomputes those equalities from canonical state records
  and rejects forged evidence. Development measurements remain available.
- _2026-07-14 -- deterministic fixed-universal development crossover measured;
  release gate remains FAIL._ Mode `0x14` adds eight independent fixed-point
  causal RLS order experts per channel, a compact one-parent graph, integer
  discounted-L1 order selection, and actual profile-0/1/3 rANS keep-best
  selection. On the frozen 13-record / 878,000-value development manifest
  `183acdb8681a6bdac763cd0b10f4d8a943f5903cfcb4cadcf48cf48e97045eec`,
  exact complete-stream measurement produced 483,303 bytes versus H.BWC's
  483,840 (ratio 0.998890; 537 bytes / 0.111% smaller). This is an aggregate
  development crossover, not a production peer claim: the subject-bootstrap
  95% gap interval is [-2.209%, +1.779%], total misses the predeclared 0.99
  gate, and EEGMMIDB (1.016156), Siena (1.028279), and TUSZ (1.032552) miss
  their corpus ceilings. Against Optimum v1, 483,303 versus 506,696 saves
  23,393 bytes or 0.213148 bit/value, clearing the integer >=0.20 bit/value
  architecture threshold. Mode `0x14` won 8/13 records and saved 16,025 bytes
  versus the prior integer-peer candidate. Result hashes are
  `81ffdacfac30ecf68537a3160825c03410af244372435993c302fd8afb0cafb4`
  (H.BWC) and
  `bd5472f40653fa2da945447f85e26cff0107b1497796ab27cddb8cfe7a35b027`
  (Optimum v1); both bind hardened predictor source
  `8213639edafa90a35059327bdd11a387ea5ca0ff1e615f270edd59c8f228dc97`.
  A Rust predictor/graph conformance core matches Python through shared fixture
  `83215276ea1a4e501fc1b15299be2dc7d6ead28599a6056e9fd8ed196b249c57`
  (graph bytes, scalar state, nominal and signed-i32 residuals, and reset
  transition). Rust entropy/BGF integration and complete packet equality remain
  open. Learned modeling remains required to earn margin and hard-corpus
  generalization.
- _2026-07-14 -- hard-gap attribution selected the first learned seam._ S006,
  PN06, and PN07 contribute 5,959 of 5,984 gross losing bytes (99.58%); S005
  offsets 689 bytes, leaving EEGMMIDB, Siena, and TUSZ 5,295 bytes behind in
  aggregate. The predeclared 0.99 total gate requires another 4,302 bytes.
  Mode `0x14`'s improvement on the four EEGMMIDB/Siena records was mostly
  serialization: graph bytes fell by 3,352 while payload improved by only 420,
  and payload became worse on S006 and PN07. The next bounded learned arm is
  therefore a causal integer CDF transport conditioner over the unchanged
  mode-`0x14` predictor, graph, event grammar, and rANS. Mandatory controls are
  identity/zero transport, temporal-only, parent-conditioned, and causal-row
  joint contexts under equal accounting. A joint claim requires improvement
  over the temporal-only control on both EEGMMIDB and Siena, S005 no worse than
  H.BWC, and complete development bytes at or below 0.99 of H.BWC. TUSZ is a
  separate framing problem: its 27-byte payload cannot recover the 25-byte
  complete-stream gap, so a compact unit-parent graph alias must be evaluated
  without attributing that saving to learned entropy.
- _2026-07-14 -- compact static-parent framing landed and the CCT-16 integer
  kernel was frozen; the learned arm remains unmeasured._ Temporal mode `0x16`
  serializes the canonical unit-weight mode-1 parent map as exactly
  `[0x16][u16 parent-or-FFFF] * channels` while retaining identical prediction,
  entropy events, and payload bytes. On the bound TUSZ record this reduced the
  graph from 195 to 67 bytes and the complete candidate from 793 to 665 bytes,
  converting the 25-byte H.BWC loss into a 103-byte win (665 versus 768) with
  exact decode. Replaying the full SHA-pinned 13-record development comparison
  produced 483,175 bytes versus H.BWC's 483,840: 665 bytes / 0.1374% smaller,
  ratio 0.998626. Measurement integrity passed, but release remains FAIL. The

# ADR 0117: Use PRODUCTION_ROADMAP as the meta-repo release progress roll-up

> **This file is append-only and living.** Append dated implementation notes to
> the Progress Log. Freeze only after the acceptance gate passes.

## Status

`Accepted 2026-07-14` → `In progress 2026-07-14`

## Context

LamQuant had several valid but narrower status surfaces. The generated ADR
index reports decision lifecycle, `STANDARDIZED_PLAN.md` holds seven-field
implementation cards, `TRUTH_LEDGER.md` owns measured claims,
`DEPLOYMENT_READINESS.md` gates medical/neural SKUs, and
`PRODUCTION_ROADMAP.md` described the neural production track. None answered
the meta-repository release question in one place: which root-tracked surfaces,
submodules, local candidates, artifacts, and cross-cutting gates are ready for
public release at their exact SHAs.

The missing roll-up made a clean checkout, an unpushed local candidate, an old
test count, and a governed release record too easy to conflate. It also left no
single place to expose drift between a checked-out submodule and its committed
meta gitlink.

## Decision

Use the existing composed `docs/PRODUCTION_ROADMAP.md` as the canonical
meta-repo progress and public-release roll-up. Its first atom records a UTC
snapshot, an overall fail-closed verdict, one row per release surface, separate
lifecycle and evidence-gate states, exact checked-out or candidate SHAs, meta
integration state, current evidence or blocker, and the next release gate. It
links to authoritative detail sources rather than replacing their metrics,
work logs, or SKU rules. For root-tracked surfaces, the audited meta base is the
release-relevant software and gitlink state before the tracker-only docs delta;
a commit limited to tracker sources and deterministic generated views does not
self-invalidate that snapshot.

## Rationale

- `docs/MASTER.md` already assigns `PRODUCTION_ROADMAP.md` the what-to-ship
  role, so expanding it avoids a second competing release-status document.
- Lifecycle and release evidence answer different questions. A candidate can
  exist locally while its release gate is `FAIL` because no remote ref or
  exact-SHA evidence makes it reproducible.
- The meta-repo integrates components by gitlink or root commit. Both the
  candidate SHA and the integration SHA must therefore remain visible.
- Fail-closed `UNMEASURED` prevents prose, cleanliness, and stale CI from being
  promoted into release evidence.
- Detailed sources remain authoritative: ADR progress logs for work state, the
  truth ledger for numbers, component release ledgers for exact-SHA evidence,
  and deployment readiness for SKU gates.

## Alternatives Considered

- **Create `PROGRAM_STATUS.md`.** Rejected because it would overlap the roadmap
  role already declared in `MASTER.md` and introduce another drift surface.
- **Use the generated ADR index.** Rejected because ADR lifecycle does not
  represent artifacts, gitlinks, remote reachability, or cross-cutting release
  gates.
- **Use `STANDARDIZED_PLAN.md` alone.** Rejected because detailed stage cards
  are the execution plan, not a compact all-component release snapshot.
- **Use `DEPLOYMENT_READINESS.md` alone.** Rejected because it intentionally
  applies stricter product/SKU gates and does not cover every public repository
  or artifact.

## Consequences

- A release-readiness answer has one entry point, while evidence remains in its
  owning ledger or component document.
- Tracker updates must be bound to observed SHAs and cached remote state; a row
  becomes stale when those inputs move.
- Adding or removing a public release surface requires updating the roadmap
  matrix and the required-surface inventory below.
- The roll-up can remain `NO-GO` while useful development continues. It is a
  release gate, not a demand that every component share one lifecycle stage.

## Implementation Plan  *(the contract — write once; amend only by a dated Progress Log entry)*

- **Deliverable:** composed `docs/PRODUCTION_ROADMAP.md` with a meta-repo
  progress atom and this governing ADR.
- **Required release surfaces:** meta integration/distribution; LML/LMA;
  Optimum v2; neural/PCCP; BLUT engine; BLUT Standard; BLUT Core; LamQuant and
  Lamu cookbooks; firmware; Eagle-LQS; OpenECS; root launcher;
  `lamquant-config`; `lamquant-history`; `lamquant-ops`; `lamquant-tui`;
  `lml-os`; Vision; and documentation/governance.
- **Acceptance gate (fail-CLOSED; unmeasured ⇒ FAIL):**
  - `gate_cmd:` `python3 tools/doc_tree_lint.py && python3 tools/doc_compose.py && python3 tools/doc_views.py`
  - `pass when:` all three commands exit zero and the composed roadmap contains
    the overall verdict, component matrix, cross-cutting gates, and update
    protocol.
- **Rollback:** remove the meta-progress atom from the roadmap composition,
  restore the neural-only introduction, and mark this ADR rejected before it is
  frozen.

## Progress Log  *(append-only; newest last; never rewrite an earlier entry)*

- 2026-07-14 — Opened after a meta-repo public-release audit found only partial
  tracking surfaces and no canonical all-component roll-up.
- 2026-07-14 — Added the progress atom, expanded the roadmap's declared scope,
  separated lifecycle from evidence gates, and recorded component SHAs,
  gitlink drift, remote reachability, blockers, and next gates. Composition and
  generated-view checks pass. The full acceptance gate remains blocked by the
  pre-existing `docs/HANDOFF.md` missing-frontmatter tree-lint failure, so this
  ADR remains in progress.
- 2026-07-15 — Release-constitution commit `416061b7` changed root checker and
  workflow controls beyond the tracker-only exception. Marked the original
  component snapshot explicitly historical and non-evidentiary; the generated
  OH! Tech family status is now the current release-control view. The component
  matrix must be re-audited on exact SHAs before any row can satisfy a gate.

## Completion / Resolution  *(fill once; this + the frozen Status line is the single freeze mark)*

Not frozen. The acceptance gate has not passed.

## Related Decisions

ADR 0116 — the active Optimum v2 work remains a detailed roadmap track rather
than becoming the meta roll-up.

## Validation  *(ongoing — distinct from the completion gate above)*

Supersede this decision if one composed roadmap cannot remain current without
duplicating authoritative evidence, or if release automation grows a generated
manifest that can replace the hand-curated matrix. Treat a snapshot as stale
whenever release-relevant root content, a listed candidate SHA, a meta gitlink,
or its cached remote reachability changes. A commit whose diff is limited to
this tracker's authored sources and deterministic generated views records the
tracker revision but does not change the audited software base.
